Packaged build of the extension.

## Installing

On Firefox, open `about:debugging`, click Load Temporary Add-on and pick this zip directly.
You do not need to unpack it. If the file dialog hides `.zip` files, rename it to `.xpi`,
which is the same format, and the picker will show it.

On Chrome, unpack the zip first, then open `chrome://extensions`, turn on developer mode
and load the resulting folder.

The package is unsigned, so Firefox forgets it when the browser restarts.

## Using it

Open a Discord channel and **click the discord-mass icon in the browser toolbar**. That is
what opens the panel, in the top right corner of the page. Click the icon again to hide it.
If the icon is not on the toolbar, open the puzzle-piece Extensions menu and pin it there.

The panel arrives with the channel you have open and your own user id already filled in, and
it follows you when you switch channels. The blue button reads Apagar and deletes for real
once you confirm. Tick Simular first if you want to see the list without touching anything.
